about.en: ON is the token of Orochi Network, a verifiable data infrastructure project that uses zero-knowledge proofs for products such as zkDatabase, the Orocle oracle and the Orand verifiable randomness service. ON (Orochi Network Token) is issued by the project on BNB Smart Chain at 0x0e4f6209ed984b21edea43ace6e09559ed051d48 and on Ethereum at 0x33f6be84becff45ea6aa2952d7ef890b44bfb59d.
